description: This file defines the PendingLeaveRequestSummary class within the OrangeHRM HR management system. The class implements an ActionSummary interface, manages leave request search parameters, and provides methods to retrieve pending leave request counts, specifically for leave requests pending approval. It utilizes traits and entities related to leave requests.

classes.name: PendingLeaveRequestSummary
classes.description: A class that summarizes pending leave requests requiring approval, providing count and grouping information, utilizing leave request filtering and services.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets up search filter parameters based on accessible employee numbers, including status filters for pending approval.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns an identifier for the group, which is 1.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the group as 'Leave Requests To Approve'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of leave requests pending approval based on current filter parameters.
